observations: Photo 0: Open shipping container packed with used automotive engines stacked on wooden plank shelves/dividers.
Photo 0: A man in a red T-shirt, red cap, grey shorts, and sandals leans into the container, inspecting an engine.
Photo 0: Engines show bare metal blocks, timing covers, pulleys, some wiring and hoses still attached; condition looks used/dismantled.
Photo 0: Man is standing on the rusty flatbed of a blue and yellow painted truck with visible rust and wear.
Photo 0: Sawdust or wood shavings visible on the truck bed, likely used as packing material.
Photo 1: Same container and truck from a slightly different angle, same man still inspecting the engines.
Photo 1: Multiple rows of engines are visible, each row separated by wooden boards; engines appear to be mixed models stacked closely together.
Photo 1: A watermark reading 'G.O MERCHANTS LTD' is visible across the image.
Photo 1: No brand or model markings are legible on any individual engine.
